notes.title: PATCH V6.04
notes.content:
[b]Changes.[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed all the test maps.
[*] Added "Flying Island" map.
[*] Optimized multiplayer game.
[*] Reworked combat mechanics.
[*] Fixed errors with bombs.
[*] Blast effects updated.
[*] New bonus (running speed).
[*] New characters added.
[*] New bombs added.
[*] Added new tasks.
[*] Fixed minor and major bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: The tournament has begun!
notes.content:
As of this minute, the tournament has begun!
The tournament will run until February 28, 2022 at 10:00 AM Pacific Time.

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] In the rankings section, a tournament section has been added.
[*] Added ranking above the Player Icon (ranking position, match wins, number of kills).
[*] Added two new missions.
[*] A new map has been added.
[*] Prices for characters and bombs have been increased.
[*] Fixed various minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Tournament with a prize fund of 1000$
notes.content:
To celebrate the release of the game in Early Access, we are launching a mini-tournament with a prize pool of $1000. This is the first trial tournament for Bomberpet. 
The tournament will begin on February 14, 2022 at 10:00 AM Pacific Time and will run until February 28, 2022 10:00 AM. The tournament is free to anyone who has a Bomberpet game.

How to participate?
You need to play ranked matches, you'll get points for winning and for killing characters.
You can see your rating in (Rating -> Tournament), which will appear at the beginning of the tournament.

Prizes:
1 - 500$
2 - 300$
3 - 200$
